items.en: "I appreciate you not wasting my time. So was Perseus your doing?"
"My silence is very much for sale."
"What are you loyal to, Macario?"
"You mentioned 'advanced spacecraft hull' in a previous conversation..."
Close the comm-link
DEV start "Passage to Volturn" / ANH
"Okay, you have a deal."
"Let me guess- you need transport, no need to involve the authorities."
"I'd be careful about trusting your feelings around here, old man."
"What's with the robot, got some kind of AI in there?"
"If you're some kind of terrorist, I don't want to know."
"If you're some kind of terrorist, I want to know."
"If you're some kind of terrorist, I want to charge more."
"It's probably best that I not ask."
"The job sounds too hot for me. Find another captain."
"Not worth my time. Find someone else."
"Why do the authorities want you so badly?"
"Sure, whatever."
"I suppose they did."
"I don't need to worry about it."
"Actually, I need to know if that thing is safe."
"Sure. If I need some farm equipment repaired I'll let you know."
"I could use a junior engineer in my fleet."
"So what's this about, old man?"
"I'll need a moment to review my passenger manifest." (stall)
"I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act."
"You have no right to kidnap my passengers."
"That isn't going to happen."
"Care to explain?"
"I don't want to know."
"I'm not handing anyone to the Diktat."
"As you wish."
"No, this ends here. I'm handing you all over."
"Take them away."
"I have someone of interest to transfer to your flagship, officer."
"I have some persons of interest to transfer to your flagship, officer."
"I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act."
"You have no right to kidnap my passengers."
"No, that isn't going to happen."
Allow the search
"Battle stations."
"It's just a moon, kid. With a rocky core."
"We all do what we gotta do to survive, kid."
"I want to help you fight the Diktat. What can I do?"
"Yes, that's me."
"Ah, so you've heard of me. Very good."
"Perhaps you've mistaken me for someone else." (lie)
"I'd like to talk about how I can help your cause."
"Aren't you Gens Kato? What are you doing on Umbra?"
"Speaking of Andrada... I've got some good news for you."
"I'm pretty sure he's braindead. Dolos Macario as much as admitted it to me."
"I think, given the circumstances, he was being relatively honest."
"I'm just a merc. He was extremely assertive about giving me a job."
"I'm on a personal mission to undermine the Sindrian Diktat."
"I'm on a personal mission to undermine the Sindrian Diktat." (lie)
"I'm a secret Hegemony agent working to undermine the Diktat." (lie)
"I'm in a deep-cover ARC cell you've never heard of working as a double agent." (lie)
"I am of the Luddic faith and I'm taking them down from the inside." (lie)
"I am of the Luddic faith and I'm taking them down from the inside."
"I'm Persean League fleet intelligence. My real name is 'Siyavong'." (lie)
"Doesn't your family, your gens, object?"
"I met Dardan. Is he your brother?"
"I salute your dedication. It is a just cause."
"It seems a doomed cause. Don't you want to go home?"
"That's very... uh, noble of you."
"That's rich talk coming from a Gens baby."
"I mean to say you're in a difficult position, but I do support your cause."
"Look, you're gens Kato. You're throwing yourself away on Umbra."
"You do what you like. Forget I brought it up, it's not my business."
"I truly have no idea what you're talking about."
"Are you telling me I could have been paid for this?"
"He is. He became... rather angry at me."
"He is. He was helpful."
"He is. He seems unhappy in his current post."
"Difficulties?"
"You mean, being stuck on a pirate-infested icecube with no fleet."
"Why not go back to Kazeron and find a way to support the fight from inside the League?"
"What if you go to Volturn. Help the, um, Volturn Covenant?"
"Your grandmother hired a freelancer to talk you out of... this?"
"Hold on, now..."
"I know someone on Westernesse who might help you. Cavin Pharoh."
"If you need safe transport to an independent world, I can arrange it."
"I did transport an old man and a kid to Volturn. I think they're part of your resistance..."
"I did transport a kid and his robot to Volturn, I think they wanted to join your resistance..."
"Do you need armaments? Supplies? Credits?"
"That's all I can think of for now."
"Then stay here and freeze! I can't solve all your problems for you."
"I think he's maybe some kind of artist?"
"I'm not sure. I just visited a slum where he was probably squatting."
"This one hacked a Hegemony Ministry for... it's a long story, actually."
"Gargoyle can be difficult, but I think they'll be a valuable asset to your cause."
"You have no idea what you're in for."
"I can't wait to hear how you get along."
Give 10 units of heavy armaments
Give 25,000 credits
Give 100 units of supplies
"Maybe another time."
One hundred thousand credits
One million credits

"I shall take my leave to consider what sort of gift befits the pirate queen."
"Great. Thanks."
"What does Kanta want?"
"So that's it? Tell her 'thanks'."
"Fine. I'll do it." (accept)
"It is my pleasure to fulfill the Warlord's wishes." (accept)
"No, there has to be some alternative." (decline)
"Are you mad? Bombard $affk_marketName? It's suicide." (decline)
Accept the mission after all
Assert that you decline Kanta's demand
"We have 'business' to discuss."
"We have business to discuss."
"I wish to discuss business."
"You'll have 10% of the gross income of my colonies and I'll tell you why you'll accept."
"10 percent is too much. Be reasonable."
"An outrageous demand! You can see the power of my $shipOrFleet from where you sit."
Accept the deal
"You justify piracy with that nonsense?"
"So you're calling me weak."
"So you're calling me powerful."
"I knew you'd see reason."
"Our agreement no longer suits me."
"It's over. Don't make me repeat myself."
"Okay, let's keep the protection deal."
Comply with the inspection
"That's nonsense, you have no such authority in this volume."
"With that fleet? You're in no position to make demands."
"Am I to understand that if I were part of the Persean League this could be avoided?"
"I was just subject to an 'inspection', don't you people talk to each other?"
Cut the comm link and power up weapons
"I'll do that. Orderly confederation with the League makes sense."
"I'll consider it, $post."
"And submit to your bullying? Not likely."
"I am wondering exactly that. Perhaps you can explain?"
"I demand to know why you're trying to blockade my independent colony!"
"You're here to strong-arm me into joining the League, aren't you."
"This is piracy! You can't just blockade any system you want!"
Explain where Reynard Hannan can stick the League Armada
"True, strength is necessary to protect freedom... from thugs like you and your bosses on Kazeron."
"True, strength is necessary to protect freedom... and we're stronger together."
"You've described a protection racket... and I'll have no part in your banditry."
"You've described a protection racket... and I want to be on the winning team."
"I assume the question is hypothetical."
"What of freedom, rights, and prosperity? Do those ideals mean nothing?"
"No- I'm building a new sector free of your tyranny."
"You'll have to pluck that treasure from my cold, dead hands."
"I'd like to talk to you about joining the Persean League."
Slam the comms off
DEV Use mind powers to make him let you into the League
"Go on..."
"...Show of force?"
Try to negotiate to have the dues waived
Accept League membership on the given terms
"Your system defense fleet, the pride of Kazeron, broke upon me."
"I defeated your blockade. You've tried to use force against me, and failed."
"I defeated your punitive expedition. You've tried to use direct force against me and failed."
"Perhaps a $hannanBribePercent fee directly to Gens Hannan accounts, for facilitating this agreement?"
"Rumor is Kazeron's pristine nanoforge is... missing. I would donate a spare I happen to have."
"I accept League membership on the amended terms."
"My colony is leaving the Persean League. Consider this official notice."
"I'm pulling my colonies out of the Persean League. Consider this official notice."
"I meant what I said. I'm done with the League."
"Never mind. I've, um, reconsidered."
"You heard me the first time - I'm done with the League."
"Never mind. I've... misspoke."
"I'm stopping the payments to Gens Hannan, effective immediately."
"I'm not asking for help. I'm telling you the payments end. Now."
"My decision to stop payments to Gens Hannan may have been ill-considered."
"Yes, I made a terrible mistake. Please accept my apologies."
"Never mind, I didn't come here to beg."
"How about I pay you half a million credits to raid the $triTachSystem instead."
"I understand. A million, then?"
Arrange the credits transfer
"Burn bright, $rank."
"Um. I've reached an understanding with Tri-Tachyon. You can stand down."
"On the contrary, I've reached an understanding with Tri-Tachyon."
"Not necessary. I've reached an understanding with Tri-Tachyon."
"How could you attack a $playerBrotherOrSister of the Faith?"
"Well?"
"I've experienced some recent 'friction' with Tri-Tachyon. It's time we made a mutually beneficial deal."
"Perhaps we can work together to solve my ongoing 'problems' with Tri-Tachyon."
"Rayan, do you think you could arrange a deal to solve my ongoing 'friction' with Tri-Tachyon?"
"I'd like to discuss the possibility of a deal to solve my ongoing 'friction' with Tri-Tachyon."
Review the proposal
"I wish to submit a complaint regarding Tri-Tachyon interference in my operations."
"So I've attracted the, ah, 'attention' of Tri-Tachyon."
"I come along?"
"This seems to be mostly about you so far."
"My question was more about Tri-Tachyon sponsoring attacks on my fleets and colonies."
"I understand. Fight covertly, cut a deal. Win-win."
"I understand. Fight covertly, cut a deal. Win-win." (lie)
"I cannot let their trespasses go unanswered; it would be dishonorable."
"You describe piracy, banditry, and might-makes-right. What of interfactional law?"
"Why can't we just talk it out and make a deal? Why all the killing?"
